description: 40 t, 2% down, full throttle from 85 km/h: fuel cut at the limiter, the speed creeps above 90 km/h (the limiter does not brake) and the overrun protection caps it (ADR 0082)

checks.source: overrun protection: limiter 90 km/h (S3) + 4 km/h offset, overshoot below 2 km/h
S3: the limiter only cuts fuelling, it does not brake - no speed drop below the limiter band on a descent
service brake not used by the overrun protection
no solver explosion / impulse spikes (per-step velocity change of either body)
